summary: Repeated the same question; prior answer didn't address it
detailed_context: Nick sent the same merge-and-release question three times. The first two attempts got API 529 Overloaded errors, so the repeats are probably retries rather than complaints about content. The last response, though, was a partial answer about whether the shared POC deployment is visible and whether the reference group could be renamed. It never addressed which repos to merge to (hub, permissions, service summary) or whether those merges trigger a release and deployment. Because he had to ask again, the answer missed what he needed. Lesson: when a question has been asked repeatedly, answer the specific question directly and first, covering each of A, B, and C, and confirm the release and deploy chain for each merge.
